description: Implementation of the HeifDecoder class, including data source management, image decoding, and slice-based processing for HEIF images within the Android platform.

classes.name: HeifDataSource
classes.description: A data source proxy that manages HEIF data streaming and caching, interfacing with MediaMetadataRetriever.

classes.name: HeifDecoderImpl
classes.description: Main implementation class for HEIF decoding, supporting image and video frames, slicing, and asynchronous decoding.

classes.name: HeifDecoderImpl::DecodeThread
classes.description: A thread class for asynchronous decoding slices of HEIF images.

methods.name: createHeifDecoder
methods.description: Factory function to create a new HeifDecoder instance.

methods.name: initFrameInfo
methods.description: Initializes HeifFrameInfo structure from a VideoFrame object.

methods.name: HeifDataSource::init
methods.description: Initializes internal buffers and shared memory for data streaming.

methods.name: HeifDataSource::readAt
methods.description: Reads data at a specified offset, managing cache and stream seeking.

methods.name: HeifDataSource::getSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the data stream if supported.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::init
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with a data stream and optional frame info.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::reinit
methods.description: Reinitializes the decoder, setting up MediaMetadataRetriever and extracting metadata.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::getSequenceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves sequence (video) info and frame count.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::setOutputColor
methods.description: Sets the output color format for decoding.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::decodeAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous slice decoding of HEIF images.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::decode
methods.description: Performs synchronous decoding of a HEIF image or frame.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::decodeSequence
methods.description: Decodes a specific frame in a HEIF sequence (video).

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::getScanlineInner
methods.description: Retrieves the next scanline of image data.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::getScanline
methods.description: Retrieves the next scanline, waiting if necessary for async decode.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::skipScanlines
methods.description: Skips a number of scanlines in the decoding process.

methods.name: HeifDecoderImpl::getColorDepth
methods.description: Returns the bit depth of the image.
